name: Joshin Corporation
summary: Joshin Corporation operates as a consumer electronics retailer in Japan. The company engages in the sale of home appliances, information and communication equipment, entertainment products, housing equipment, and related products, as well as incidental businesses. It is also involved in general renovations, planning, design, and construction of extensions and remodeling; seismic reinforcement; delivery, installation, repair, and maintenance services for home appliances and other related products; and installation and configuration of information equipment and communication equipment.
